goal: Audit all 11 current primary-screen contact sheets and production UI against Lazyweb and Material 3, with special attention to cross-screen typography, shapes, heading hierarchy, light/dark contrast, expressive identity, icon consistency, and redundant icon-plus-text actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Every SCREEN-001 through SCREEN-011 is reviewed from actual golden evidence.
Lazyweb reports run strictly one screen at a time and terminal URLs/findings are recorded before the next submission.

The output includes a Material 3 compliance matrix, cross-screen token/typography/shape/contrast audit, complete icon inventory, redundant icon-plus-text findings, and a prioritized implementation brief.
No production files are changed by this review assignment.
